thread:
emma-csm: @support-team CSM reported a customer seeing repeated JSON parse failures after we rolled model v2.3. They say numeric order_id is now being returned quoted (\"12345\") and the shipped boolean field is intermittently omitted (appears as null on their side). Client validation rejects payloads.
raj-support: can you paste the exact request/response pair the customer sent?
emma-csm: customer provided this minimal repro. Request: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"invoice-structured-v2","prompt":"Parse the invoice into JSON: items, order_id, shipped"}'
```
Response snippet they received: 
```json
{"status":"ok","result":{"order_id":"12345","items":[{"sku":"A1","qty":2}],"shipped":null}}
```
marta-qa: that response will fail strict JSON schema validation when order_id is typed as integer and shipped is non-boolean/null depending on schema. Did the customer enable strict_json_mode?
emma-csm: yes, they enabled strict_json=true on the route. They only started seeing errors ~1708190000 after we promoted invoice-structured-v2 to default.
david-eng: looking at model outputs in logs: after the v2.3 rollout we see a spike in tokens where numeric ids are wrapped in quotes. Parser treats quoted numbers as strings which breaks the downstream typed schema. Also some completions omit boolean fields entirely or emit explicit nulls. Repro rate in our test harness ~3/10 (intermittent).
raj-support: is this hosted-only or also happening on Dedicated/Private?
emma-csm: hosted only so far (customer is using hosted API).
david-eng: quick debug: this prompt + strict_json reproduces locally 2/5. Example minimal prompt we used: 
```
Prompt: \"Convert to JSON with keys: order_id (integer), shipped (boolean)\"
Model: invoice-structured-v2
strict_json: true
```
Result sample: 
{"order_id":"98765","items":[{"sku":"B2","qty":1}],"shipped":null} 
raj-support: customer reports these failures cause them to retry requests and they were billed ~100k extra tokens due to noisy retries. They want a rollback or immediate mitigation.
sara-csm: customer is on an annual contract with committed usage; they're upset about incorrect responses + billing churn. We should prioritize.
raj-support: short-term mitigation: route their traffic to previous model variant (invoice-structured-v1) and enable a parser fallback that coerces numeric strings to integers and treats null/absent as false for shipped. I'll open an incident.
david-eng: long-term: add schema-aware postprocessing that coerces numeric-ish strings to numbers when schema expects it, and add a model-output sanity check in the catalog that flags increases in quoted-number patterns during rollouts. Also look at sampling/config diff between v2.2 -> v2.3.
bot-deploy: [deploy-bot] rollout invoice-structured-v2 -> started 1708189000, health degraded at 1708193450, partial rollback triggered.
raj-support: created INC-4821, PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/support/fix-string-numeric-coercion (cc @david-eng). Routing change staged for the customer.
emma-csm: pinging customer with temporary routing and apology. Will monitor.
raj-support: will follow up after 24h and check token billing adjustments with finance if needed.
